vars.team_intro: For significant features or changes that are more than a few lines of code, use [Claude Code agent teams](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams) with a structured multi-agent approach.
vars.guard_hooks: A `PreToolUse` hook blocks the engineer's edits to sealed files (in whichever attached repo the file lives) and holdout reads where the agent is identifiable, and a `TaskCompleted` hook blocks completing any task while a sealed test is modified.
vars.worktree_section: **All teammates share one workspace dir.** Before creating the team, run `team-guard workspace new <feature>`, then `team-guard workspace attach <repo-path>` from the workspace dir for each repo the feature touches. Each attached worktree is on the same branch name in its repo. Create the agent team from the workspace dir so every teammate inherits it as its working directory; each teammate edits code inside `repos/<repo>/`, and the workflow artifacts stay in the workspace dir.
vars.phase_intro:
### Phased execution with task dependencies

Use task dependencies to enforce phase ordering. Teammates within a phase can work in parallel; cross-phase work is blocked until dependencies complete.
vars.goal_mechanics: Claude Code checks the condition after every turn with a small fast model and keeps working until it's met, judged impossible, or cleared by an error you have to fix. Evaluation waits while subagents or teammates are still running. Run it in auto mode so goal turns don't stop for permission prompts; `/goal` shows status and `/goal clear` stops it.
